sentences.text: At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that petitioners are the brother-in-law of the deceased victim and the complaint in this case has been lodged by the sister of the deceased victim.
It is further submitted by the counsel for the petitioners that there are vague and general allegations with regard to the cruelty for demand of dowry with no specific instances.
It is further submitted by the counsel for the petitioners that petitioners reside separately in separate houses and seldom visit the house of the deceased victim.

It is further submitted by the counsel for the petitioners that sister of the complainant i.e deceased victim has only made a complaint on the basis of which FIR was registered but she never joined the investigation with the IO and the complaint filed by the complainant is malicious as the complainant wanted money from the accused persons.
4. Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State enters appearance and accepts notice.
He seeks time to file the status report.

5. Let status report be filed before the next date of hearing.
6. List on 3rd October, 2023.
RAJNISH BHATNAGAR, J MAY 22, 2023/ib
